title: Global Unrest: Current World News Recap
description: This summary highlights global news, including legal actions against a Philippine senator, Taiwan's response to US-China relations, terrorist drone attacks, and Iran's military tensions. Also covered are updates on Ebola outbreaks, political shifts in Palestine, and Trump's diplomatic moves concerning Greenland. Developments in Peru's elections and US religious events are discussed.

title: Lai Says Taiwan Won’t Be Sacrificed as Trump Weighs Arms Deal
description: Taiwan’s President Lai Ching-te said the self-ruled democracy cannot be traded away, days after US President Donald Trump described a planned $14 billion arms sale to Taipei as a bargaining chip with China.

title: Trump Advisers Concerned China May Target Taiwan in Next 5 Years
description: The adviser added that this trip signaled a much higher likelihood that Taiwan will be on the table in the next five years. The adviser also warned that the United States remains vulnerable to disruptions in semiconductor production centered in Taiwan.

title: South China Morning Post
description: Regardless of the meeting’s outcome, the trend towards resolution of the Taiwan question won’t change, according to the Tsinghua academic.

title: US-China Talks: Commitment, Trade, and Strategic Stability
description: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer discussed President Trump's achievements with China, focusing on a commitment to abstain from supporting Iran. While the Strait of Hormuz reopening wasn't on the table, trade negotiations advanced, including China's agreement to resume US meat exports and purchase Boeing planes.

title: Taiwan’s president defends US arms purchases that Trump called ‘bargaining chip’
description: The U.S., like all countries that have formal ties with China, doesn’t recognize Taiwan as a country but has been the island’s strongest backer and arms supplier.

title: China Blocks Taiwan Again From Global Health Forums Despite US, EU Backing
description: Taiwan has once again been excluded from the World Health Assembly (WHA), marking the 10th consecutive year that Taipei has been denied participation due to pressure from China, as reported by The Taipei Times.

title: China condemns Conservative MP’s Taiwan trip after ambassador’s warning
description: China claims sovereignty over democratically governed Taiwan, and says by allowing MPs to travel there, Canada is 'interfering in China's internal affairs.'

title: Taiwan’s president defends U.S. arms purchases that Trump called bargaining chip
description: Taiwan’s president says arms purchases from the United States are crucial for regional stability, after President Trump questioned continued support for the island following his visit to China.
